description: HTML page containing embedded Common Lisp code defining functions and macros for binary stream manipulation, specifically for reading and writing integers, bytes, and strings in a Common Lisp mode for CodeMirror.

methods.name: integer-reader
methods.description: Macro to create functions for reading integers of specified byte size and signedness from a binary stream.

methods.name: integer-writer
methods.description: Macro to create functions for writing integers of specified byte size and signedness to a binary stream.

methods.name: write-bytes
methods.description: Function to write a byte array to a stream.

methods.name: write-str
methods.description: Function to write a null-terminated string to a stream, with optional UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: read-bytes
methods.description: Function to read a byte array of specified length from a stream.

methods.name: read-str
methods.description: Function to read a null-terminated string from a stream, handling UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: skip-bytes
methods.description: Function to skip a number of bytes in a stream.

methods.name: skip-str
methods.description: Function to skip a null-terminated string in a stream.

methods.name: ensure-socket-is-closed
methods.description: Function to close a socket stream safely, ignoring errors.
